usedFor: Edusign holds the students and courses, and Google Drive shares a file through “Share File With Anyone” after “New Student”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Student” in Edusign, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new student is when course material is needed, so the file gets a link then.

watchOut: “New Student” in Edusign is polling, so “Share File With Anyone” runs after a scheduled check.
